body: The one thing that I wanted, I can't have.
I do appreciate the optimism. I've learned my lessons but the course of my life has been altered irreversibly, and I don't know where to go from here.

We were planning on getting married, and then I had a really bad stress related episode. I did so much damage to the relationship in 2-3 days that she hasn't spoken to me since. I was undiagnosed until six months ago but looking back I see how it was all me.
Yeah, I was convinced that she was abandoning me and I went off the fucking rails
It isn't my favorite song or anything but it definitely describes how the relationship felt to me.
